items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Louis Jordan's Tympany Five... Louis Jordan had signed for some dates and that he had not come to fulfill these engagements.

ctx.x: Because what it's done...it has killed band leaders. They don't have any organized small groups. Years ago you had the Savoy Saltons, Louis Jordan's Tympany Five, you know... you name it and you had a group. But today you don't have any of that.
All you have is All Stars...
